study.comparator: insulin lispro Mix25 twice daily titrated (pioglitazone third arm not entered)
study.notes: STUDY: single centre substudy (Drum Tower Hospital, Nanjing) of the multicentre randomised trial NCT01147627 (342 patients, exenatide vs insulin vs pioglitazone in drug naive type 2 diabetes): 33 nonobese drug naive patients randomised after a 1 week run in to exenatide (5 ug twice daily, 10 ug twice daily from week 4; dose_mg 0.01 per injection), insulin lispro Mix25 twice daily titrated, or pioglitazone 30 to 45 mg, 11 per arm, 6 months (24 weeks); the insulin arm is the comparator entered, the pioglitazone arm is a second active comparator not entered (one contrast per trial); Table 1 (Springer table page, companion capture bi2014_acta_diabetol_table1.txt) prints pre and post treatment per arm as mean plus or minus SE with n 11 (route arm_change_imputed_r_sem, amendment A8: SE as printed in the sd columns, converted by the pipeline, correlation 0.5); the results text prints per arm changes as mean plus or minus SE for HbA1c, total cholesterol, TNF-alpha and intrahepatic fat (route arm_sems, preferred where available); liver fat by 1H-MRS (IHF) entered under liver_fat_pdff as in Dutour 2016; the substudy aim is liver fat and body fat distribution (prespecified TRUE for the liver fat row, FALSE for the others); pct_weight_change from the Table 1 means in the exenatide arm, 71.1 to 66.5 kg, minus 4.6 kg equals minus 6.5 percent (results text gives a mean change of minus 5.0 kg; insulin 65.2 to 64.3 kg, minus 1.4 percent); funded by NSFC and national grants, no conflicts declared (industry_funded FALSE); rob_overall high

rows.notes: Results text: HbA1c change per arm mean plus or minus SE, exenatide minus 2.9 plus or minus 0.4 vs insulin minus 2.8 plus or minus 0.3 percent (three group P 0.158); Table 1 pre and post 8.6 plus or minus 0.4 to 5.7 plus or minus 0.1 and 9.1 plus or minus 0.3 to 6.3 plus or minus 0.2 (SE)
Table 1: fasting glucose mmol/L pre and post per arm, SE as printed (n 11 per arm); baseline differed between arms (P 0.002)
Table 1: fasting insulin uIU/mL pre and post per arm, SE as printed; the insulin arm receives exogenous lispro Mix25, which the assay may measure
Table 1: triglycerides mmol/L pre and post per arm, SE as printed; results text exenatide change minus 19.1 plus or minus 11.0 percent, insulin not significant

Results text: total cholesterol percent change per arm mean plus or minus SE, exenatide minus 12.8 plus or minus 4.7 (P 0.023 within arm) vs insulin minus 9.1 plus or minus 5.4 (P 0.027); Table 1 pre and post 5.3 to 4.5 and 5.1 to 4.5 mmol/L
Table 1: LDL cholesterol mmol/L pre and post per arm, SE as printed; text: LDL did not change in any group
Table 1: ALT U/L pre and post per arm, SE as printed; results text exenatide change minus 34.0 plus or minus 13.5 percent (P 0.043), insulin no change
Table 1: AST U/L pre and post per arm, SE as printed; text: AST did not change in any group

Results text: plasma TNF-alpha percent change per arm mean plus or minus SE, exenatide minus 62 plus or minus 19 (P 0.012 within arm) vs insulin minus 60 plus or minus 17 (P 0.002); Table 1 pre and post 7.6 plus or minus 1.9 to 1.2 plus or minus 0.5 and 8.6 plus or minus 1.7 to 2.2 plus or minus 0.8 ng/mL (SE)
Table 1: plasma adiponectin ug/mL pre and post per arm, SE as printed; results text exenatide change plus 118 plus or minus 24 percent (P 0.008), insulin not significant (no value printed)

Results text: intrahepatic fat by 1H-MRS, relative change per arm mean plus or minus SE, exenatide minus 68 plus or minus 6 (27.4 plus or minus 5.5 to 6.3 plus or minus 1.4 percent, P 0.004) vs insulin minus 58 plus or minus 9 (23.7 plus or minus 5.0 to 9.1 plus or minus 2.9 percent, P 0.012); the reduction did not differ between the three groups (P 0.454, three group test, recorded not used); MRS fat fraction entered under liver_fat_pdff as for Dutour 2016

json.design: single centre randomised three arm substudy (exenatide vs insulin lispro Mix25 vs pioglitazone) of NCT01147627 in drug naive nonobese type 2 diabetes, 33 randomised, 11 per arm, 24 weeks, 1H-MRS liver fat and MRI fat depots
json.reason: full text group (institutional route); eleven inventory markers: four from the results text as per arm changes with SE (arm_sems) and seven from Table 1 pre and post means with SE (amendment A8 route); the insulin arm is the comparator, the pioglitazone arm is not entered
biomarkers_reported_no_variance: VAT (visceral fat area by MRI, exenatide 159.3 plus or minus 14.4 to 104.1 plus or minus 16.0 cm2, change minus 36 plus or minus 6 percent; the insulin arm values are in Fig. 1 only, not printed)
HOMA_IR (Table 1 prints 1/HOMA-IR, exenatide 0.28 plus or minus 0.05 to 0.58 plus or minus 0.11, insulin 0.28 plus or minus 0.06 to 0.32 plus or minus 0.10; the reciprocal is not converted)
IL6 (no significant effect stated, no values printed)
other_markers: 30 and 120 min glucose and insulin after a meal test
correlates of the change in intrahepatic fat (Tables 2 and 3)
tables_used: Table 1 (companion capture from the Springer table page)

rob.justification: randomised within a registered multicentre trial, the substudy sequence and concealment not described and the baseline fasting glucose differed between arms (D1 some concerns); open label with titrated insulin and pioglitazone comparators (D2 some concerns); 33 analysed with no flow statement for the substudy (D3 some concerns); MRS, MRI and laboratory assays (D4 low); substudy outcomes beyond liver fat not prespecified in the citation given (D5 some concerns); small open substudy with several domains at some concerns, overall high

doubts: Table 1 prints SE, not SD; rows are declared arm_change_imputed_r_sem and the pipeline converts with the square root of 11 (amendment A8)
fasting insulin in the comparator arm reflects exogenous lispro Mix25 measured by the assay
the per arm percent changes in the text (HbA1c, TC, TNF-alpha, IHF) were preferred over the Table 1 pre and post values where both exist
the pioglitazone arm (strong adiponectin and VAT effects) is excluded as a comparator; the Director may prefer a second contrast
